content.en: UNESCO plays a pivotal role in the **Creative Economy**, which encompasses knowledge-based economic activities upon which the 'creative industries' are based. By fostering international cooperation, it influences policy frameworks that impact **Human Capital Development** and **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**. In the context of the Indian economy, UNESCO's recognition of World Heritage Sites directly influences the **Tourism Sector**, contributing to foreign exchange earnings and local employment generation.
